report:
**Conclusion: The claim is TRUE.**

The Kyleena (levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system) 19.5 mg IUD is FDA-approved for the prevention of pregnancy for up to five years. Multiple authoritative sources confirm this:

1. **FDA approval**: Kyleena was first approved by the FDA on September 16, 2016, specifically for prevention of pregnancy for up to five years. Bayer's official press release announcing the approval states it is indicated "for prevention of pregnancy for up to five years." ([Drugs.com FDA Approval History](https://www.drugs.com/history/kyleena.html); [PR Newswire press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/fda-approves-bayers-kyleena-levonorgestrel-releasing-intrauterine-system-195-mg-for-prevention-of-pregnancy-for-up-to-five-years-300330006.html))

2. **FDA label / prescribing information**: The official FDA label and prescribing information state that "Kyleena® (levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system) is a hormone-releasing IUD that prevents pregnancy for up to 5 years." ([Kyleena Prescribing Information – Bayer](https://labeling.bayerhealthcare.com/html/products/pi/Kyleena_PI.pdf); [FDA label PDF](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2021/208224Orig1s002lbl.pdf))

3. **Clinical evidence**: A Phase 3 study was conducted with a 3-year duration and an optional extension of Kyleena use up to 5 years, supporting the five-year indication. The cumulative 5-year failure rate is approximately 1.4%, with a 5-year Pearl Index of 0.29. ([DailyMed – NIH](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=2e07c155-21e1-4781-9633-ce8bddd47080))

4. **Independent corroboration**: HeaLio reported that "The FDA has approved Kyleena for the prevention of pregnancy for up to 5 years." ([Healio](https://www.healio.com/news/primary-care/20160920/fda-approves-bayer-iud-kyleena))

In summary, the claim is accurate and well-supported by FDA labeling, the manufacturer's prescribing information, and independent medical sources.
